# mimecast_dmarc_policy_presets (Data Source)

Read complete typed DMARC Analyzer policy presets with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_policy_presets" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC policy-preset inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Preset description.
- `dkim_alignment` (String) DKIM alignment mode.
- `failure_report_format` (String) DMARC failure report format.
- `failure_reporting_options` (String) Colon-delimited DMARC failure reporting options.
- `id` (String) Preset ID.
- `is_default_policy` (Boolean) Whether this is the default preset.
- `name` (String) Preset name.
- `percentage` (Number) Policy application percentage.
- `policy` (String) DMARC policy action.
- `report_interval` (Number) Aggregate report interval.
- `rua_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Aggregate report recipients.
- `ruf_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Forensic report recipients.
- `spf_alignment` (String) SPF alignment mode.
- `subdomain_policy` (String) DMARC subdomain policy action.
- `version` (String) DMARC definition version.
